_note: v2.8 plan 53, owner decision 2026-10-25 (no-model lane): a group-disabled member does not hear a `present` faction move. Arin is disabled in the open group by a checkpoint cast change (ST's own disabled_members, read back through expect.groupDisabled), a present-heard move fires: rep_guild_seen_narrator follows the move, rep_guild_seen_arin keeps its start value. Arin is re-enabled by the next checkpoint and a later boundary commits: nothing is granted retroactively, also not after a reopen. Run: node scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run test/scenarios/v28-53-disabled-hears-no-present.json --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator', twice.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; globalThis.storyOrchestratorDebugExtractionResponse = 'SCENE_NONE'; const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); for (let id = ctx.chat.length - 1; id >= 0; id -= 1) await ctx.deleteMessage(id, undefined, false); if (ctx.chat.length !== 0) throw new Error('the sandbox chat still holds ' + ctx.chat.length + ' message(s)'); return { cleared: true };

const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0, stabilityLag: 0 }); const pause = (ms) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms)); const until = async (test, ms, what) => { const end = Date.now() + ms; for (;;) { const value = await test(); if (value) return value; if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out after ' + ms + ' ms: ' + what); await pause(200); } }; const values = () => rt.getEngineState().blackboard.values; const pick = () => { const v = values(); return { rep: v.rep_guild, arin: v.rep_guild_seen_arin, narrator: v.rep_guild_seen_narrator, move: v.rep_guild_move_stole, boundary: rt.getEngineState().boundary }; }; const enabled = () => [...rt.getEnabledCharacterIds()].sort().join(','); const saved = async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 100 && rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null; i += 1) await pause(100); if (rt.getSnapshot().saveHealth?.pendingBoundary != null) throw new Error('the last boundary is not saved'); }; const reopen = async () => { const chatId = SillyTavern.getContext().chatId; await SillyTavern.getContext().reloadCurrentChat(); await until(() => rt.getSnapshot().storyId === 'so-v28-53-disabled', 10000, 'the story to hydrate after the reopen'); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chatId !== chatId) throw new Error('the reopen moved the page'); rt.setUiSettings({ authorView: true }); await pause(1500); }; globalThis.__d53 = { pause, until, values, pick, enabled, saved, reopen }; await until(() => enabled() === 'arin,narrator', 10000, 'both members enabled at start'); const start = pick(); if (start.rep !== 0 || start.arin !== 0 || start.narrator !== 0 || start.move !== undefined) throw new Error('standing is not seeded at its start: ' + JSON.stringify(start)); globalThis.__d53.start = start; return start;

const d = globalThis.__d53; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!(await rt.activateCheckpoint('errand'))) throw new Error('errand did not activate'); await d.until(() => d.enabled() === 'narrator', 15000, 'Arin to be group-disabled'); return { enabled: d.enabled(), at: rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId };

steps.slash: /sendas name="DM Narrator" raw=false While Arin is out, your hand closes on the guild ledger and you slip it under your coat.

steps.eval: const d = globalThis.__d53; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (d.enabled() !== 'narrator') throw new Error('Arin is not disabled when the move fires: ' + d.enabled()); await rt.setQuality('ledger_stolen', 'true'); await d.until(() => d.values().rep_guild === -3, 10000, 'the move to lower standing'); const after = d.pick(); if (typeof after.move !== 'number') throw new Error('the move latch is not set: ' + JSON.stringify(after)); if (after.narrator !== -3) throw new Error('the enabled member did not hear the present move: ' + JSON.stringify(after)); if (after.arin !== d.start.arin) throw new Error('the group-disabled member heard the present move: ' + JSON.stringify(after)); await d.saved(); d.moved = after; return after;

const d = globalThis.__d53; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; if (!(await rt.activateCheckpoint('return'))) throw new Error('return did not activate'); await d.until(() => d.enabled() === 'arin,narrator', 15000, 'Arin to be re-enabled'); return { enabled: d.enabled(), at: rt.getEngineState().activeCheckpointId };

steps.slash: /sendas name="Arin" raw=false Arin hangs her cloak by the door and lights the hall lamp.

steps.eval: const d = globalThis.__d53; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const before = rt.getEngineState().boundary; await rt.setQuality('lamp_lit', 'true'); await d.until(() => rt.getEngineState().boundary > before && d.values().lamp_lit === true, 10000, 'a later boundary with Arin enabled'); const later = d.pick(); if (later.arin !== d.start.arin) throw new Error('re-enabling granted the move retroactively: ' + JSON.stringify(later)); if (later.rep !== -3 || later.narrator !== -3 || later.move !== d.moved.move) throw new Error('the standing moved again: ' + JSON.stringify({ later, moved: d.moved })); await d.saved(); return later;

const d = globalThis.__d53; await d.reopen(); const reopened = d.pick(); if (reopened.arin !== d.start.arin || reopened.narrator !== -3 || reopened.rep !== -3 || reopened.move !== d.moved.move) throw new Error('the reopen changed who heard the move: ' + JSON.stringify(reopened)); if (d.enabled() !== 'arin,narrator') throw new Error('the reopen changed the cast: ' + d.enabled()); return reopened;
globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setUiSettings({ authorView: false }); await globalThis.__d53.pause(800); delete globalThis.__d53; return { authorView: false };
